sloka: न त्वां क्रोधयितुं शक्तोन क्रुद्धां प्रत्युदीक्षितुम्।तव प्रियार्थं राजा हि प्राणानपि परित्यजेत् ॥२-९-२५॥
transliteration: na tvāṁ krodhayituṁ śaktona kruddhāṁ pratyudīkṣitum।tava priyārthaṁ rājā hi prāṇānapi parityajet ॥2-9-25॥

translations.english: The king is afraid of inciting your ire. When you are angry, he dare not look at your indignant countenance. Indeed he will forsake even his life for your pleasure.
